The work needs fixing, mainly because one of the three asks isn't built and the folder-rename approach breaks other things. I wrote the full review to `mastermind-session-names/review.md`; its first line is `verdict: fix`.

There was no `requirements.md` in the task folder, so I took the brief from the original agent's first prompt in its transcript. The diff changes no page and there were no screenshots, so the review covers only Requirements and Words. The work is one commit, `9b4fe7c98`, on `worktree/session-names`, and it hasn't been merged.

**What works**
- **Ask 1 (the "no session undefined" error):** fixed as far as I can tell. The session tools now take the session id from the calling agent's own name instead of trusting the model to type it. Nothing in the logs or tests reproduces the original error, so it isn't proven to be the root cause.
- **Ask 4:** dropdown rows still read "Name (time ago)".

**What needs fixing**
- **Ask 3 isn't built.** Untitled sessions still show "Session v-xxxxxxx". There's no label taken from the first words or the summary, which your addendum asked to be the default.
- **Ask 2's approach breaks lookups.** It moves the session's folder every time the title changes. But other code finds a voice session by its folder name: the sessions index uses the folder name as the id, and `/framework/ai/sessions/v-<id>/` links redirect by it. A renamed session gets a new id in the index and its old link stops working.
- **Moved folders take task records with them.** A voice session's folder holds its task folders, so every link into it breaks, and the move leaves no record of old and new paths. The simpler route is to name the folder once, when it's created, and never move it.
- **The live tail breaks after a rename.** The code that should point the smart assistant's file-watch at the new path compares two path formats (one has `public/`, one doesn't), so they never match.
- **It runs `git mv` in your main working tree** while Servex is running. That stages renames in your index alongside the log-sweep commits.
- **Docs are out of date:** the sessions readme still describes folders as `v-<id>`, and nothing documents the new `rename_session` tool. The new `renamed` live event is also undocumented, and nothing on the page side handles it.
- **The task isn't finished:** no screenshot (the brief asked for one), no merge, and no outcome logged. A fresh agent couldn't pick it up from the task folder alone.

**Notes**
- The new refresh-on-click in the dropdown does nothing on the click that opens it, so the first list you see can still be out of date.
- The assistant's brief now says to name the session "once the topic is clear" instead of in its first turn. If the folder stops moving, the stricter first-turn rule may be worth keeping.

The work still needs fixing: two of the owner's three asks aren't met. The full review is in `mastermind-session-names/review.md`, and its first line is `verdict: fix`.

The task folder has no `requirements.md`, so I took the brief from the original agent's first prompt in its transcript. The diff changes no page and there were no screenshots, so the review covers only Requirements and Words. The diff covers both commits (`9b4fe7c98`, then the round-two fix `02d27a969`) on `worktree/session-names`, which is not merged.

**What works**
- **Ask 1 (the "no session undefined" error):** fixed as far as I can tell. The session tools now take the session id from the calling agent's own name instead of trusting the model to type it. The worktree's session tests pass (27 checks), but nothing reproduces the original error, so it isn't proven to be the cause.
- **Ask 4:** dropdown rows still read "Name (time ago)".

**What needs fixing**
- **Ask 3 still isn't built.** Untitled sessions still show "Session v-xxxxxxx", with no label from the first words or the summary. This was the first finding last round, and the fix commit didn't touch it.
- **Ask 2 is no longer met.** Moving the folder was dropped for a good reason: the agent was given the folder's path when it started, and moving it would break that path. But nothing replaced it. Titled sessions now show a title in the dropdown and a `v-<id>` folder name, so the two names still differ. The reason is written only in code comments, so the owner hasn't been told.
- **Docs describe something that doesn't exist.** The session docs and the `session_summary` tool's description say an open page updates the title live when the title changes. Nothing on the page side actually listens for that update.
- **A fresh agent couldn't pick this up.** The task folder has no `requirements.md`, no outcome line, and no screenshot (the brief asked for one). Nothing in the folder says the commits are waiting unmerged.

**Smaller notes**
- The dropdown's refresh-on-click still shows the old list on the click that opens it; the code comment admits this.
- The voice assistant now waits until the topic is clear before naming a session. Without the fallback label, that means more "Session v-xxxxxxx" rows, not fewer.
- The new `rename_session` tool only exists for a rename flow that isn't built yet, so it could wait until that flow is.

The proposal `requirements.md` is clear, so I rewrote nothing and logged one "clear" line in `flags.jsonl`. Its owner asks are numbered and its outcome is short.

`text-check.mjs` flagged only `review.md` in the same folder. That file has several paragraphs over 60 words and 751 words of prose with no picture. It's the reviewer's file, so I didn't touch it.
